incident-bot: PAGER: P1 - auth-service JWT validation errors across prod, sustained 401 spike. Pager routed to auth-oncall.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident #ID12345 triggered, escalation policy: auth-oncall. Notifying primary/secondary.
Rachel (oncall-auth): ack — I'm on it. grabbing logs + traces. @Mike FYI.
Rachel (oncall-auth): symptom summary: token validation endpoint returning 401 for tokens that should be valid. Starts ~10:12 UTC.
Sam (sre): seeing same. 401 rate up ~30% across regions. Keystore fetches showing 5xx/504 from keystore cache layer.
Sam (sre): logs excerpt:
```
2026-03-14T10:12:01Z auth-1 ERROR validate_token failed: invalid_signature kid: 'rdw-2026-rot'
http_request GET https://keystore.internal/keys -> 504 (cache-miss -> origin timeout)
2026-03-14T10:12:03Z signer-2 INFO issued token kid=rdw-2026-rot
```
Dinesh (eng): we did a key rotation ~7m before spike (rdw-2026-rot). Looks like signing pushed new kid before JWKS propagation finished + keystore cache was flapping.
Dinesh (eng): recommend temporary fallback to accept previous keyset (legacy key) while we stabilize cache and make propagation atomic.
Rachel (oncall-auth): can we flip the feature flag to accept legacy keys? @Mike can you run the control plane toggle?
Mike (service-owner): running toggle now — CLI:
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/flags/feature/auth_accept_legacy_key -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"enable":true}'
```
Mike (service-owner): API returned 200. Propagation to edge in ~10s.
Sam (sre): metrics update: /v1/auth/validate error rate down from 32% -> 3% within 90s of toggle. Latency stable.
Tilly (CS): CS: we've got 6 enterprise customers who opened tickets reporting login failures. We're pinging them with an acknowledgement and mitigation note.
Amy (Product): need quick impact summary and next steps for customer comms. ETA on root cause and permanent fix?
Dinesh (eng): root cause write-up: race between key rotation and JWKS propagation + keystore cache eviction bug under load. Fixes: (1) make JWKS publish atomic so new kid isn't used until jwks available; (2) add retry/backoff on keystore origin; (3) change signing path to tolerate short temporary JWKS mismatch for X seconds. I'll open PRs and link.
Rachel (oncall-auth): escalation: if we don't have full mitigation by 10:45 UTC escalate to infra lead. Handoff plan: @Sam will take next 30m for stabilization, then hand to @oncall-2 for long-term followup.
Sam (sre): doing detailed timeline and will post incident summary in #incidents. Creating postmortem template now.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: acknowledged by Rachel at 2026-03-14T10:14:12Z. Escalation to Mike at 2026-03-14T10:20:00Z.
Rachel (oncall-auth): quick incident summary for PMs: affected endpoints: /v1/auth/validate, /oauth/token. Window: ~10:12 UTC — 10:34 UTC (~22m). Mitigation: enabled legacy-key acceptance at 10:16 UTC; full rollback of key push at 10:34 UTC. Impact: ~0.8% of active sessions experienced auth failures; 6 enterprise customers reported issues.
Tilly (CS): CS will send short customer note: "We experienced a brief authentication outage affecting a subset of sessions. We implemented a temporary mitigation and are working on a permanent fix. We'll follow up with details and timeline."
Rachel (oncall-auth): leaving channel for handoff to Sam. I'll remain reachable by pager for any regressions. :white_check_mark:
Sam (sre): acknowledged. I'll coordinate the postmortem and action items (PRs for atomic JTWS publish + cache hardening). Adding timeline and MTTx metrics to the doc.
